item.text: {"search_note":"On the other side: I did not find credible evidence that Khamenei refrained from manipulating electoral rules or state institutions in 2024. The closest neutral fact is that the regime still held elections and allowed a narrow slate including one moderate, but the sources above show that slate was tightly filtered and not meaningfully competitive.\n\nSearch gap: No reliable 2024 evidence surfaced showing Khamenei genuinely stayed out of candidate vetting, courts, media, election administration, security force pressure, or public-resource favoritism.
